en: Illustrated postcard featuring a large red wine glass in the foreground with an ornate stem. Inside the bowl of the glass is a circular vignette showing two people in traditional dress drinking wine, framed by grape vines and a ribbon. Behind the glass are large dark grape clusters and green leaves. On the right side is printed red German text sending greetings from Styria and mentioning the Landhaus in Graz, with additional handwritten notes across the bottom.
